dog.description_text:
Meet Dorito! 🧡

This handsome 1-year-old boy was rescued from the Bronx and is ready to find a home to call his own!

Dorito is a sweet boy who loves being pet and has plenty of affection to give. He may take a moment to warm up, but once he does, he’ll happily soak up the love and attention.

One thing Dorito knows for sure? He wants to be your one and only! He absolutely does not enjoy the company of other cats and would be happiest as the king of his own castle, without any feline roommates.

All Dorito needs is a loving home where he can feel safe, settle in, and be someone’s special boy.

No cat siblings, please — Dorito wants all the love for himself! 🧡🐾
dog.name: Dorito
